deliverables: 12 months of frontend and backend maintenance and development
Backend infrastructure, operations, monitoring, and incident response
Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
Public reporting of Pro plan earnings, repayment, and donation transaction hashes
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements while Eternl introduces paid Pro plans.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $420,000 using an Ada conversion rate of $0.1787, for a 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027.
The proposal states that Eternl's annual operating cost is about $420,000, funding 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.

Eternl says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, deposit it into a public company wallet, return any Ada above that amount to the treasury, and keep pre-conversion Ada undelegated to an SPO and delegated to abstain voting.

The proposal says the Audits allocation is for periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics, not technical security audits, with audits planned for February 2027 and August 2027 by an unaffiliated party.

Eternl proposes semiannual repayment checks in December and June, using surplus treasury stablecoins plus paid plan income above $420,000 to repay up to the received $420,000 value in Ada, then donating 50% of paid plan income above $420,000 until an additional $210,000 worth of Ada is donated.

The proposal states that Eternl will introduce Pro plans priced at $96 per year for Personal and $360 per year for Company, and that about 5,500 users, or 4.2% of its install base, would fully cover the $420,000 annual cost.
Eternl claims an install base of about 100,000 browser-extension users and about 30,000 Android and iOS users.
Eternl claims 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The proposal states that Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet for web, browser extension, Android, and iOS that users rely on for payments, staking, governance, and DApp interaction.

The proposal states that if treasury funds are not approved and paid plans do not sell enough licenses beyond August, Eternl may let developers go, scale down to essential maintenance, shift focus outside Cardano, or remove the free option.

summary: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000 for 12 months of wallet operations, maintenance, support, infrastructure, governance tooling, and fund-use audits, with a proposed path to sustainability through paid Pro plans and conditional treasury repayment.
